item.description:
Release v5.7.4

Changes since v5.7.3

  • feat(A4PaperView): support custom content as container view
  • feat(activityheatmap): make ActivityHeatmapSettingsStore public for external access
  • feat(ActivityHeatmapPlugin): persist selected period and default to last 30 days
  • feat(AppManagerPlugin): enable rail visibility for app list panel
  • feat(AppManagerPlugin): move refresh button to title toolbar with notification-based trigger
  • feat(LLMProviderMLXPlugin): display model description in model list UI
  • feat(LLMProviderMLXPlugin): register separate LLM provider per model series
  • feat(LLMProviderMLXPlugin): update Qwen models list with latest Qwen3 series
  • feat(LumiKernel): add conversation-scoped onLumiMessagesDidChange overload
  • feat(ModelSelector): show model capability badges and context window size in model list
  • feat(ThemeManager): 注册主题菜单到菜单栏
  • fix(BookletMaker): use landscape orientation for output sheets and update explanation diagrams
  • fix(BookletMakerPlugin): safely handle PDF drops via loadFileRepresentation
  • fix(ConversationSpeed): scope message-change notifications to selected conversation
  • fix(DatabaseManager): adjust saved connections section layout in empty state view
  • fix(LLMProviderMLX): mark localization extractionState as stale
  • fix(LLMProviderMLXPlugin): filter SettingsView to show only the current provider's series
  • fix(MessageList): gate overlapping tail refreshes and scope notifications to selected conversation
  • fix(MessageManager): merge pending in-memory messages with disk reads
  • fix(MiniMax): buffer SSE frames across network chunks + extract nested provider message
